label: major lien fund: retention/safe-payment date
basis: 10% retained for 60 days from the certificate of substantial performance; payment may validly be made after that if no lien is registered

label: minor lien fund: retention/safe-payment date
basis: 10% of post-certificate work retained for 60 days from completion

label: annual/phased holdback payment
basis: an owner MUST pay holdback early only if the contract provides annual/phased payment, the price exceeds $10,000,000, and no liens are filed - not computed

label: holdback to retain (amount, not a date)
basis: CAD 125,000.50 x 10% = CAD 12,500.05 retained. The statute applies the rate to the value of the work actually done; you chose the base (check with your accountant or lawyer whether tax is in it). Rounded half-up to the cent (the rounding rule is not stated in the text we read - unverified).
